prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Changes:
0: [sign_in, reorder] Move Sign-In after Adoption Selection: Move account sign-in to take place after pet selection so users build connection and motivation before creating an account. (why: Adoption has a high drop-off (60.9% conversion) and forcing sign-in up front adds friction before users experience pet customization.)
1: [sign_in, hint] Account Sign-In Persistence Hint: Add explicit hint text on the sign-in screen explaining that signing in restores existing pets and prevents account duplication. (why: Top support report (8 emails) involves pets missing or resetting after signing in again.)
2: [home, wait_info] Live Generation Progress & Tip Carousel on Waiting Screen: Display progress indicators and helpful tips while waiting for the pet setup to complete. (why: The waiting screen has a very long mean duration (2336s) and median (201s), causing drop-off.)
3: [choose_path, layout] Centered Mascot Intro on Story Screen: Change the initial story screen layout to centered with an animated mascot greeting the user. (why: Choose path drops 23.8% of users with an average time of 514s, indicating initial engagement drops off early.)
4: [home, notification] Ready Notification Toggle during Waiting Step: Add an option to notify users when pet generation is finished so they don't abandon the app while waiting. (why: Mean wait time is over 38 minutes (2336s), leading users to close or minimize the app and forget about it.)
5: [finish, copy] Clear Desktop Spawning Instructions on Home Intro: Update the home intro text to clearly explain that the pet will appear directly floating on the desktop screen. (why: Support received reports of pets not showing up on desktop or users believing the desktop app failed to launch.)

scores.note: Delaying friction until after adoption builds investment, targeting a major drop-off step.
Directly addresses top support report regarding missing pets after sign-in with cheap text change.
Reduces perceived waiting time during 200s+ load times using engaging content.
Visual polish on early screen with modest impact on initial drop-off.
Helps recover users abandoning during lengthy 38-minute average background generation.
Low-cost copy update addressing high finish drop-off (35.2%) and explicit support confusion.
